desc: Implement the trie plus per-depth predicate plus binary search solution in the provided starter code.
Build trie with prefix counts and store each word's trie node id at each depth for path membership queries.
For each depth, compute whether any prefix has count > k and exact-k prefix information capped at two (count and unique node id).
Binary search each word's answer using feasibility predicate: count>k at depth, or at least two exact-k prefixes, or one exact-k prefix not on the word's path.
Handle edge cases in code: n-1 < k, k == 1, duplicate words, words shorter than queried depth, and total length constraints.
Validate the current solution on sample tests and edge cases; if any fail, fix the failing case or switch to the trie active DFS fallback.
